title: Bound automatic portfolio launches by an explicit top-K limit

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Feature: Frozen automatic execution top-K

  Scenario: Diagnose several candidates but launch only one
    Given an automatic portfolio run has multiple complete diagnosis-ready targets
    And max_execution_targets is one
    When execution policy is applied
    Then only the highest-priority ready target is selected
    And remaining ready targets stay visible as deferred by the execution limit
    And no more than one optimizer child is dispatched

  Scenario: Reject an unsafe execution limit
    Given max_execution_targets is zero, negative, non-integral, or greater than five
    When the portfolio run freezes its specification
    Then it fails closed before optimizer dispatch

  Scenario: Resume with the same frozen limit
    Given a portfolio run checkpoint records max_execution_targets
    When the run resumes
    Then a changed limit is rejected as a different run specification

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the frozen max_execution_targets contract. The Tactus portfolio procedure defaults to five and callers may explicitly choose one through five; direct legacy runner calls without the field retain prior uncapped batching behavior. Deterministic rank order is preserved, over-limit ready targets remain visible with execution_target_limit evidence, and stakeholder projections label them as later-run deferrals rather than launch failures. Validation: new red/green top-one and invalid-limit tests plus the full 245-test portfolio/report/YAML suite pass; Python flake8 and diff checks pass.
